about: Rules for shared/sync.py: each copies 'from' (a file, or every file below a folder; relative to shared/) to 'to' (relative to images/<name>/) in each listed image.
images: "*" = every images/<name>/ with a Dockerfile (new folders join on their own); otherwise an explicit list of folder names.
Copies are byte-identical and committed. After changing a source or a rule: python3 shared/sync.py; CI runs python3 shared/sync.py --check.
Removing a file from a source folder doesn't delete its old copies: delete them by hand.
